title: fix: keep updates working below recommended Node security patches
body:
## What Problem This Solves

Fixes: updates are refused, or an explicitly pinned Gateway runtime cannot restart after an update, when Node meets the previous compatibility requirements but lacks the latest security-only patches.

## User Impact

Users can update on Node `>=24.16.0 <25 || >=26.1.0` without first upgrading Node. Updates, Doctor, and `openclaw security audit` prominently warn below Node 24.22.1 / 26.12.1. **Upgrade Node promptly:** these patches reject keys compromised in the October 2026 eMudhra incident; continued compatibility does not remove that exposure. SQLite safety checks, excluded release lines, explicit target-package engines and patched provisioning defaults remain enforced.

## Why This Change Was Made

Separate compatibility from security recommendations in the canonical version policy instead of stranding installations. Audit finding `runtime.node_security_patch` describes the audit process runtime, not an unprobed Gateway, and skips Bun. Audit collectors use a coherent sibling module.

## Evidence

- **Original explicit-pin upgrade:** real AWS Crabbox 2026.10.5 updater → private patched runtime snapshot, unchanged Node 24.21.0 native service pin, exit 0, visible warning and new healthy Gateway PID. This predates the audit extraction/main refresh and remains separate source-stamped evidence. Service and worker cleanup confirmed.
- **Exact-head fresh install:** candidate `6d987863ea42cfd9ec70eec4c445725a4746e17d` installed/set up on checksum-verified Node 24.21.0. Real Gateway readiness 200, successful read-only RPC serving the exact build, new PID after cold restart and preserved synthetic settings. Doctor lint visibly warned about security patches; exit 1 reflected the warning, not an error or clean lint. Cleanup verified.
- **Latest stable:** genuinely installed 2026.10.8 (`dc2523e`) public updater activated that exact candidate on Node 24.22.1 in a supervised offline rootless namespace. Exit 0 / `status: ok`; real snapshot/install/Doctor/canary/activation/finalization, preserved chosen settings, and new foreground Gateway readiness 200 / RPC success with the exact build. This was a stopped baseline → `--no-restart` updater → owner-started new process, **not** automatic/native-service restart or old-Node pin proof. Latest stable itself refuses the old-Node baseline. Synthetic-profile warnings retained; process/container teardown and removal verified; no host supervisor guard changed.
- Actual Node 24.16.0, 24.21.0 and 26.1.0 CLI audits warned with exit 0; patched 24.22.1 had no Node finding. Human audit and JSON update dry-run showed the advisory.
- Red/green compatibility/audit regressions and focused runtime, updater, worker, Doctor, preinstall and Bash installer tests passed. All 12 CI-repair test files passed across the focused run and corrected audit-fixture follow-up. Core/scoped types, lint, format, Bash syntax, documentation links, export guard and test-line ratchet passed. Net test-line growth zero against `c7db2804`, ceiling unchanged. Explicit target-engine, runtime-recovery and unsafe-SQLite coverage retained.
- Independent refreshed-candidate/final-delta local review, Codex GPT-6.1 Sol, P0–P2: scoped-clean. Hosted findings about remaining consumer expectations and duplicate audit export were repaired.
- **Final CI remains red:** [run 40647541620, attempt 2](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/actions/runs/40647541620/attempts/2) completed all 185 jobs. Eight test jobs failed with nine independently baseline-reproduced groups: seven monotonic-deadline fixture failures, browser-like import without `process.getBuiltinModule`, and missing QA `replyToId` after actual hard-kill/restart. Final logs preserve those signatures and actual checkout `9267c251` / first parent `703618fa`; blob equivalence binds the source-equivalent baseline, not execution of the entire first-parent commit. The aggregate classification report timed out and is not used as attribution. The single diagnosed Node-download infrastructure recovery succeeded: Node setup and extension lint now pass; independent `security-fast` passed. The authorized inherited-failure exception is selected, without waiving enforced review, security or live writer authority. Feishu is not failing this run and was not classified from passing replays.
- Native macOS and Windows PowerShell execution remain unqualified; 46 PowerShell cases were skipped.
